r.정치 구도: Since independence from Portugal in 1975, Frelimo, a party born of the liberation movement, has never lost power. Soon after independence it fought a 15-year civil war against the Renamo rebels, and although multiparty elections have been held since the 1992 Rome peace accords, Frelimo has won every one. When the ruling party's candidate was declared the winner of the October 2024 presidential election with more than 70% of the vote, the opposition candidate denounced fraud and led months of street protests. Two opposition figures were shot dead just after the vote, and many people were killed as the protests were put down. In 2016 it emerged that state-owned companies had secretly borrowed about $2 billion under government guarantees, leading the IMF and several donor countries to suspend support, and the 'hidden debts' scandal remains a byword for corruption and broken trust.

t.why: From around 2010, a string of discoveries in the Rovuma Basin off the northern province of Cabo Delgado revealed some of Africa's largest gas fields and drew in the world's energy majors. But from 2017 an insurgency linked to the Islamic State attacked the region, and after the 2021 assault on Palma, TotalEnergies halted construction of its onshore liquefied natural gas project. Rwandan troops and a Southern African Development Community force moved in and retook key towns, and work resumed in January 2026, though the attacks have not fully stopped. For landlocked Malawi, Zimbabwe and Zambia, the ports of Beira and Nacala are a gateway to the sea. Unusually for a former Portuguese colony, it joined the Commonwealth in 1995.
t.rel: It is fighting an Islamist insurgency in Cabo Delgado in the north with help from Rwandan troops and SADC. It is the sea gateway for landlocked Malawi, Zimbabwe and Zambia, and deeply connected with South Africa through energy and labor migration.
t.korea: South Korea established diplomatic relations with Mozambique in 1993 and opened an embassy in Maputo in 2013. KOGAS holds a stake in the Area 4 project off the northern coast. Coral Sul, the floating liquefied natural gas facility serving that block's Coral field, was built by Samsung Heavy Industries and has been producing gas since 2022, and a second unit for the same block, Coral Norte, was launched at Samsung Heavy's Geoje shipyard in January 2026. South Korea has named Mozambique a priority partner for development cooperation, supporting agriculture, health and vocational training.
t.know: Mozambique's flag shows a rifle, honoring the struggle for independence.
etext: The Rovuma Basin's gas ranks among the world's largest reserves. Production started first from floating facilities offshore, and once the big onshore liquefaction plants are finished, exports and public finances could change dramatically. The TotalEnergies-led project is targeting first output in 2029.

It mines coal, rubies, graphite and mineral sands. The Cahora Bassa dam on the Zambezi is one of Africa's biggest hydropower plants and sells electricity to South Africa. The Mozal aluminum smelter, long a large share of exports, shut down in March 2026 after failing to secure affordable power.
Minerals and grain from inland countries leave through Mozambique's railways and ports. Maputo port, close to the South African border, is also an export outlet for mines in northern South Africa.
It is one of the world's poorest countries, and the hidden-debts scandal left a heavy public debt burden. Cyclones and floods strike often; Cyclone Idai in 2019 devastated the Beira area.
firms: Onshore liquefied natural gas, led by TotalEnergies
